title: cancelJob request
description: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}:cancel - request. Requests cancellation (REST face of CancelFanOutJob.v1): cancelRequested=true; tasks are cancelled when they try to start; completion is reported by FanOutCompleted.v1 (CANCELLED).
$comment: Source: DISENO S4 (b), (d) StartFanOutUseCase/CancelFanOutUseCase/FanOutStatusQuery, (e) operator APIs (RF-121), AP-F6, AP-F7; PRD RF-121, RF-022; US-08.2.1; DISENO 4.4 CMD-05 CancelFanOutJob.v1 ('Operator (S4 API)'); FW-014; RF-111. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); job view is OPERATIONAL (counters, no engagement ids). Idempotency: Idempotency-Key required; idempotent by jobId (already cancelled -> same 202); runs the same use case as CancelFanOutJob.v1 and sends no message (DEC-24). Pagination: n/a.

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120). idempotency-key is required on every write (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35).
